question: Can the frozen Test 6 radial clock be embedded in the action-consistent axisymmetric two-center scheme without immediate numerical or zero-neutral failure?

method.action: SS OCF 1 flat decoupling with fixed doublet direction Phi=(phi,0), U=s-s²+s³, Z=1+0.2s, Vchi=0.25-0.4s+0.2s² and zeta=0.1; canonical neutral momentum and reciprocal backreaction.
method.units: c=hbar=m=M0=1, rho,z,t in m^-1; phi,a,chi in m, E,Q in m and charge units.
method.domain: Axisymmetric annular finite volume; isolated rho<24, |z|<32 and pair rho<24, |z|<64; h=.8,.4; d=72 determined before run from the measured 99.9% clock radius 17.8.
method.boundaries: Regular zero-area axis and reflecting outer faces; no absorber, extraction or emitted-energy claim.
method.initial_data: Frozen Test 6 0.900 profile and mode with verified bytes, chi peak .001, Pi=-0.9i phi, a=pi_a=0; naive in-phase pair superposition with centers ±36. No post-preparation forcing or relaxation.
method.solver: Closed-cell variational face Hamiltonian, canonical RHS and RK4 with dt=.04,.02 (CFL safety <=.25); 16 time units; samples every .16; save full final fields and both conjugate momenta.
method.tolerances: Short pilot conservation <0.001 for E and Q; exact zero-neutral in saved state; full G0–G9 not evaluated. Runtime max 300 CPU seconds, 300 wall seconds, 1 GiB RAM, 100 MiB disk.

hypotheses.prediction: Regular-axis spatial core and two distinct pair peaks, exact zero-neutral preservation, short conservative ledgers.
Axis stencil or embedding produces failed conservation, nonzero neutral excitation, or a demonstrably unusable pair.

controls.purpose: separate embedding transients from pair interaction
controls.method: same frozen radial profile at one center on both grids
h=.8 and .4, with separate dt according to declared CFL; does not yet isolate timestep error
a=pi_a=0 for all scenarios and check saved maxima

criteria.pass_if: Exact supplied Test 6 profile hash matches.

criteria.fail_if: Any nonzero sample in deterministic zero-field RHS.
criteria.uncertainty: Exact arithmetic invariant; finite-precision zero checked.

criteria.observable: Maximum relative E and Q drift
criteria.uncertainty: Direct Hamiltonian/charge recomputation; finite mirror box.

criteria.unresolved_if: Short unrelaxed pilot omits these controls.

criteria.pass_if: All held-out gates with two channels pass.
criteria.fail_if: Completed controlled runs violate a gate.
criteria.unresolved_if: Not run in this prerequisite stage.
